name: Early Homo (genus-level, earliest attestation)

taxonomic_status.classification: Genus Homo, unassigned to species at the earliest attested material
alternative_classifications: Some researchers dispute genus-level assignment of the earliest (LD 350-1) specimen from dental/mandibular material alone
A 2026 minority proposal (Towle) would fold Australopithecus, Paranthropus, and Kenyanthropus into an expanded Homo reaching back ~4-5 Ma

notes: Represents the taxonomically contested earliest material assigned to genus Homo, not a coherent single population. See claim_ld350_earliest_homo and claim_ledi_geraru_overlap_2025.
